runs.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_count FROM biz_addr ba JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id

SELECT CONCAT(p.frst_nm, ' ', p.lst_nm) AS sales_person, t.nm AS territory
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN prsn p ON sp.ref2 = p.ref1
JOIN sls_terr t ON sp.ref1 = t.trrt_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT DISTINCT v.nm
FROM vnd v
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2
JOIN prod p ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_mdl pm ON p.ref1 = pm.prdc_mdl_id
WHERE pm.nm = 'Women''s Tights'
SELECT MAX(bm_lvl) FROM bom WHERE ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, SUM(sod.ordr_qty) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(sod.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sod
JOIN prod p ON sod.ref1 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM so_hdr JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id JOIN sls_terr ON cust.ref2 = sls_terr.trrt_id JOIN cnty ON sls_terr.ref1 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013 AND cnty.nm = 'Canada'

SELECT p.nm
FROM prod p
WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM so_dtl d
    WHERE d.ref2 = p.prdc_id
  )

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) FROM so_dtl sd JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes' AND YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013
